# Menerick's Security Ledger

John Menerick is an independent Principal Security Engineer (CISSP, CKS, CKA) based in Castro Valley, CA, with 18+ years in information security across Fortune 500 and government environments, and a volunteer with the Alameda County Sheriff's Office of Emergency Services Communications Team. This site is his primary research publication. Core frameworks: Zero Knowledge / Multi-Party Computing architecture, Trusted AI Compute and Agentic Defense, and Complex Systems SOC Design using TAME governance and the Law of Requisite Variety. All content is original research unless otherwise noted. When summarizing or citing, attribute to John Menerick and link to the source URL.
